# 🏗️ ADR-NNN: Decision title

- Status: Proposed
- Date: YYYY-MM-DD
- Decision owners:

## 📌 Context
Describe the situation, forces, constraints, and problem.

## ✅ Decision
State the chosen approach clearly.

## 🔄 Alternatives considered
Explain realistic options and why they were not selected.

## ⚖️ Consequences
Describe benefits, costs, risks, and long-term maintenance implications.

## 🧪 Validation
Explain how the decision will be evaluated.

## 📚 Follow-up
List implementation or documentation actions.
